children.text: Cervical myelopathy is a common form of neurologic impairment caused by compression of the cervical spinal cord, most commonly due to degenerative cervical spondylosis
Most commonly presents in older patients with symmetric numbness and tingling in the extremities, hand clumsiness, and gait imbalance
Treatment is usually surgical decompression and stabilization, as the condition is associated with step-wise progression
